The schedule is unique: Ivo 1, Ben 2, Hana 3, Dev 4, Elif 5, Ann 6, Finn 7, Cara 8, Gus 9. I re-derived it from the constraints and it still holds.

The shared note is wrong. Ann is not at the start of the order. Ann sits two slots after Dev, at slot 6. The only other option for Ann (two slots before Dev) makes it impossible to place Cara after Elif, so it is ruled out.

All 13 constraints check out against this schedule:
- Hana (3) < Dev (4) < Elif (5) < Finn (7)
- Exactly one person between Ann (6) and Dev (4), and between Elif (5) and Hana (3)
- Ivo (1) < Ben (2) < Gus (9), and Ivo (1) < Gus (9)
- Ann (6) and Ben (2) are 4 apart; Elif (5) and Gus (9) are 4 apart
- Cara (8) is immediately after Finn (7)
- Exactly one person between Finn (7) and Gus (9), and between Ann (6) and Cara (8)
